gameDescription: 3D Snakes & Ladders: Quality Education Edition is a 3D board game where you move by answering curriculum-aligned questions. Choose a subject, roll the dice, and use ladders or avoid snakes based on how well you answer.
sdgDescription: This project supports UN Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education — making learning accessible and engaging through play, immediate feedback, and questions that build from basic understanding to critical thinking.
